text:
alex kim: Quick check — launch day is D-4. We need a concrete partner oncall roster + press escalation chain. Can folks confirm availability?
maya rao: I can take the morning shift (PST) for partner questions.
leo park: I’ll cover PST afternoons and overlap with APAC.
jordan wells: Happy to own the escalation path for SI partners, will be on standby D-1 through D+1.
sasha ivanova: I’ll coordinate with hardware partner SIs; need the final partner contact list. Who has the latest?
priya singh: putting the master contact sheet here: https://docs.internal/redwood/launch-partner-contacts (please request access if you need it).
alex kim: thanks priya. Quick proposal for roster (times in UTC):
```
- D Launch Day (UTC)
  - 06:00-12:00 — alex kim (partner ops)
  - 12:00-18:00 — leo park (partner & SI overlap)
  - 18:00-00:00 — maya rao (press + partner triage)
  - 00:00-06:00 — jordan wells (SI escalation)
```
Can you confirm those windows?
maya rao: the windows work for me, I’ll be available for press liaisons 18:00-00:00 UTC.
leo park: confirmed. I’ll also watch the marketplace metrics dashboard for onboarding spikes.
sasha ivanova: shared partner contacts updated with engineering POCs and oncall numbers. Added a column for 'preferred escalation method' (pager, slack call, phone).
priya singh: added press contacts and embargo notes to the same sheet. Also added a 'press escalation' column — who is primary for press-first issues?
jordan wells: assign press escalation primary to press-team first, then to maya, then to me. If legal is needed, tag @legal-escalations.
press-team: noted. We’ll prepare a short press statement template for quick responses and a list of pre-approved Q&A.
alex kim: good. We should also define severity levels and post-to-channel behavior. Proposed quick rules:
- Sev 1: production outage affecting >10% product users or marketplace listing down — call all leads, ring phone tree, escalate to execs.
- Sev 2: partner-onboard blocking but limited impact — handle via dedicated partner channel and update twice an hour.
- Press-trigger: any media inquiry goes to press-team immediately, DO NOT post public comments without PR signoff.
leo park: can we add a tiny runbook snippet to the sheet for each Sev with one-click actions? I can add links to snippets.
alex kim: yes please. Also add fallbacks for model routing if a partner region is degraded (default to hosted fallback region US-WEST).
maya rao: for press escalation — we should have a 1-line approved quote and an overflow call tree. I’ll draft the 1-liner and share.
priya singh: sharing draft press 1-liner in 10m.
ops-bot: Reminder — create calendar invites for oncall shifts with phone numbers and Zoom bridge.
alex kim: ops-bot — create invites and tag the partner channel.
ops-bot: Calendar invites created and shared to #partnerships and #launch-day-ops.
sasha ivanova: one last ask — hardware SI needs firmware contact and deployment window. I already pinged their PM, waiting on confirmation.
jordan wells: if they need an emergency rollback, our rollback play is in the repo under ops/rollback-v1.md. Link added to sheet.
maya rao: small ask — can folks confirm time-off blackout windows for D-2 to D+2? Marked as mandatory.
leo park: confirmed blackout for me.
priya singh: marked everyone as tentative busy in the calendar invite for blackout.
alex kim: perfect. Final checklist before we close this thread: 1) oncall invites — ops-bot done, 2) contact sheet — priya/sasha updated, 3) press 1-liner + Q&A — maya/press-team draft, 4) runbook links added — leo/jordan, 5) severity rules agreed. If no objections I’ll lock this and export a PDF runbook for partners.
press-team: thumbs up from us.
leo park: +1.
sasha ivanova: +1.
jordan wells: +1.
maya rao: +1 — I’ll post the final 1-liner by EOD. :thumbsup:
alex kim: locking in, thanks all. I’ll post the final PDF and ping partner leads tomorrow morning.
ops-bot: Thread archived for follow-ups — use /launch-checklist to reopen.
